name: Pestle
description: Slain enemies have a chance, scaling with overkill damage, to be crushed into [gold]primordial dust[/gold], which can be crafted with [effect:cry][dark-gray]crystals[/dark-gray][/effect] and socketing gems to duplicate them.

effects.explanation: Lapis Lazuli, Nether Quartz, Amethyst Shards, Prismarine Shards, Diamonds, and Emeralds.
